You'll have direct ownership over cluster architecture across compute, networking, storage, and physical design — translating customer requirements into production-ready, commercially optimised GPU deployments. This is a senior hands-on role for someone who has lived and breathed HPC cluster design and wants to be the technical authority, not one voice in a committee. You'll own designs end-to-end and see them go live. What You'll Be Doing Rather than a long checklist, here's what success in this role looks like: Own end-to-end cluster architecture for large-scale NVIDIA GPU deployments — from customer requirement through rack layouts, BOM, power and cooling design, to production handover Design high-performance network fabrics across compute (InfiniBand, RDMA, NVLink/NVSwitch), storage, and WAN — defining topology, oversubscription models, and scaling strategies Engage directly with OEMs and vendors — validating hardware configurations, reviewing quotes, and ensuring designs are both technically sound and commercially optimised Provide technical oversight during deployment and bring-up — supporting hardware validation, performance testing, and acting as escalation point for complex integration issues Act as a senior technical leader across Solutions Architecture, Cloud Engineering, and data centre partners — contributing to standardised reference designs and building out the HPC engineering function About You We're more interested in how you think and work than in a perfect CV. Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and risk registers, managing project scope, change control, and milestone tracking throughout the project lifecycle. Coordinate site surveys, site readiness, logistics, equipment delivery, installation, commissioning, and customer acceptance in conjunction with field service and clinical engineering teams. Deliver projects to agreed time, cost, quality, and safety targets, reporting progress and performance against defined project KPIs. Proactively identify, manage, and escalate project risks, issues, and dependencies to protect delivery outcomes. Digital Health & Clinical Systems Implementation Manage the deployment, configuration, and integration of clinical information systems and digital health solutions, including Nervecentre EHR, Hyland PACSgear, and Philips Capsule Medical Device Integration. Coordinate technical configuration, interfacing (e.g. HL7 / FHIR), data migration, and integration with hospital IT infrastructure and existing clinical systems, ensuring that the relevant technical teams deliver their respective components . Work closely with clinical IT, biomedical engineering, hospital informatics, and vendor partners to plan and execute testing, validation, cutover, and a safe, clinically‑assured go‑live. Oversee end‑user readiness, training coordination, and post‑go‑live support / hypercare to ensure successful clinical adoption. Ensure clinical, operational, data security, and cybersecurity requirements are met in line with vendor, healthcare, and regulatory standards. Manage vendor and supplier partners to ensure competitive, reliable, and scalable delivery. Coordinate and schedule internal resources – clinical field service engineers, clinical application specialists, and clinical IT specialists – to align capacity with the project portfolio. Ensure adherence to SOPs, supplier partner training standards, service protocols, and quality management systems across all project activity. Strong IT proficiency and a good understanding of hospital IT infrastructure, networking, and interoperability standards. Proven ability to manage budgets, schedules, risks, and cross‑functional teams to deliver projects on time and on budget. Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels. Full UK / IOI driving licence & eligibility to work in the United Kingdom and/or Republic of Ireland. Willingness to travel across IOI and UK to customer and installation sites as required. #cardiacservices
